content.title: The Hodgetwins
content.text: Chuck Norris shares why he made the switch from Democrat to Republican.Reporter: "Why are you a conservative, sir?"Chuck Norris: "Well, I used to be a Democrat, but unfortunately the Democrats went too far to the left and the Republicans moved into the position that the Democrats were 40 years ago. And so, what the Democrats believed 40 years ago, the Republicans believe today. And so I realized that I had to go to a Republican because the Democrats just got too far off the trail. They just got completely off the trail and lost all reality of what America stood for. And so I realized that Republicans at this point in time are more focused on what is best for America than what the Democrats are."All reactions:173Lin ChavezMy parents were Democrats when they had morals and they were for the people. They are also now Republicans and they have voted that way because of the morals that conservatives hold.109Steve WehrleIt’s a shame that millions of people still can’t understand that.89Johnny ForsytheWhen I was 18 I registered myself as a democrat. This was Obama’s first term. My parents were democrats and I knew next to nothing about politics. So I just registered as a democrat, because that’s what my parents were. As time went on I began doing my own research, and I made the switch in my early 20s. I wanted to vote with my heart and not what other people think. I wanted my values still intact. During Obama’s second term I did not vote. I didn’t want to vote for Obama and I didn’t like Romney. 2016 came and I voted for Trump. I voted for him 3 times actually. The funny thing is now my whole family is Republican. I guess you can say I helped guide them across lol But the truth is they knew what the democrat party was becoming. And they wanted no part in that. A part of me wishes I didn’t vote demcrat, when I was 18. But that’s in the past now and I was young. I consider myself more of a conservative, with my Christian backgroud. Some people may say well that’s what Republicans are. But that’s not compelety true. Its good to see more and more people waking up. But the democrats has done it to themselves, with all that woke nonsense.255Brandon Erickson20 years ago I aligned more with democrats but today I align more with conservatives. Not because my values or beliefs changed but as a result of the democrats going so far left I became republican by default.22Sean FromeyerI like to think chuck said that. If so, it was spot on and perfectly said. My grandfathers were democrats, they would both be republicans today.292911Walter JayanthThat's the most balanced Chuck Norris joke I ever heard.In fact he didn't move. The whole Republicans vs. Democrats agenda moved to suit Chuck Norris Patricia PensmighterMy mom was a Democrat up until Ronald Reagan. She said that the focus of the Democratic party had changed. So that's when she switched. The more I read about both parties the choice was obvious. Republican.11
